subject: Request: expired promo credits for BrightVector pilot
messages:
From: Trevor Mills <trevor@brightvector.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expired promo credits for BrightVector pilot

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the pilot — the team saw promising latency and cost numbers. We were running our final integration tests last week and noticed our trial credits expired on May 18th. We had a handful of long-generation runs queued and they failed once the credits hit zero.

Our legal and procurement teams are finalizing the SOW, and we expect to sign in early June. To avoid stalling the rollout and get one last set of production-like runs, would Redwood consider re‑instating the expired promo credits for another 30 days or providing a short extension?

I attached a quick usage snapshot and the SOW draft for context. Happy to jump on a call if you want to walk through specifics.

Thanks,
Trevor Mills
Head of ML Engineering | BrightVector
[attachment: usage_report_may2026.csv (text/csv, 48KB)]
[attachment: BrightVector_SOW_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 220KB)]

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
To: Trevor Mills <trevor@brightvector.com>
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-20T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expired promo credits for BrightVector pilot

Hi Trevor — appreciate the quick note and the attachments. Glad the pilot numbers looked good.

Short answer: we can usually offer a one-time extension for pilots that are actively moving toward a purchase, but I need a couple of things to get approvals:
- a short comment on the remaining planned test runs and estimated token consumption (you gave a snapshot, but a 1-line estimate helps)
- confirmation of expected sign date for the SOW (or any blockers from procurement/legal)

Looping in Dylan (CS) to confirm whether a 30‑day credits extension covers the run plan, and Grace (sales) to sign off on the promotional exception. If both approve, we can push a credit top-up to your account within 24 business hours.

Proposed compromise if you need more runway: we can extend credits for 45 days or issue a $3,000 promo credit now and reconcile against the first invoice. Which would help more?

Thanks — talk soon.
Evelyn Hart
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0182
evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

From: Trevor Mills <trevor@brightvector.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: legal@brightvector.com
Date: 2026-05-22T14:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expired promo credits for BrightVector pilot

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the speedy reply.

Estimate: we have ~1.2M tokens left across the queued tests (mostly long form generation), which by our rough calc is about $1,600 of usage on Redwood pricing. We expect to sign the SOW by June 4th; procurement had one last redline regarding data retention but that's moving quickly.

Between the two options, a $3,000 promo credit would be easier for us to reconcile internally and ensure the queued runs complete without extra coordination. If you can apply that now, we’ll finish the final tests this week and target signature first week of June.

Also, attached: small updated usage CSV with the queued job IDs for reference.

—Trevor

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: Trevor Mills <trevor@brightvector.com>
Date: 2026-05-28T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expired promo credits for BrightVector pilot

Evelyn / Dylan — reviewed Trevor's usage and the tight sign timeline. Approving one-time promo credit of $3,000 to BrightVector.

Please take these actions:
1) Evelyn — apply $3,000 credit to BrightVector account and set expiration 60 days from grant date (to give some buffer if signature slips).
2) Dylan — monitor the queued jobs and confirm completion; flag any abnormal token spikes.
3) Evelyn — update the HubSpot deal (deal RV-2026-451) with the credit note and attach the SOW draft.

Evelyn, once done, loop Trevor and legal so they have the record. I'll note this as a promotional one-time exception in our credit approvals log.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
